# wimboot 2.9.0

Upstream: https://github.com/ipxe/wimboot/releases/tag/v2.9.0

The unmodified BIOS/UEFI hybrid binary is from the official iPXE release.
USOS uses its BIOS real-mode Linux boot protocol entry to start local Windows PE.
